scenario_metadata.title: Factory Energy Intelligence & Process Optimization Platform - Canonical Hackathon Demo
scenario_metadata.facility_type: Automotive Tier-2 Precision Machining & Stamping SME
scenario_metadata.location: Bhosari Industrial Estate, Pune, Maharashtra, India

tariff_and_grid_parameters.emission_source: Central Electricity Authority (CEA) India CO2 Baseline Database Version 19

items.item: 3-Phase Digital Smart Energy Meters (RS485 Modbus RTU, Class 1.0)
Industrial DIN-Rail Edge IoT Gateway (Quad-core, RS485/Ethernet/WiFi/MQTT)
IP65 Control Enclosure, Shielded Twisted-Pair RS485 Cabling, Power Supplies
Installation, Wiring, CT Ratio Setup & Calibration Commissioning

seven_step_narrative_mapping.name: MEASURE
seven_step_narrative_mapping.evidence: 8 digital meters capturing V, I, kW, kVA, PF, and cable I2R losses across 7 plant feeders.

seven_step_narrative_mapping.name: UNDERSTAND
seven_step_narrative_mapping.evidence: Normalizes dynamic electricity draw against variable production throughput.

seven_step_narrative_mapping.name: DETECT
seven_step_narrative_mapping.evidence: 6 fault modes detected with 100% recall; 44,564 raw alerts clustered into 447 operational incidents.

seven_step_narrative_mapping.name: DIAGNOSE
seven_step_narrative_mapping.evidence: Distinguishes electrical contactor degradation, mechanical bearing friction, and sensor loss.

seven_step_narrative_mapping.name: RECOMMEND
seven_step_narrative_mapping.evidence: Prioritizes maintenance and operational actions ranked by financial impact (INR/mo) and simple payback.

seven_step_narrative_mapping.name: OPTIMIZE
seven_step_narrative_mapping.evidence: Eliminates idle energy, shifts flexible loads from peak to off-peak, and restores mechanical health under strict production invariance.

seven_step_narrative_mapping.name: VERIFY
seven_step_narrative_mapping.evidence: Guarantees 100.0% production preservation while achieving 16.73% SEC reduction and 18.63% cost reduction.
